prompt: Create a neutral white clay render of a modernist kitchen island and dining area with seating, hanging pendants, and open shelving. No textures, no colors, only soft white matte materials, honest lighting from a wide skylight above, subtle AO in the corners. Architectural visualization style, used for form study. No watermark.
riskNote: 第三方图文案例仅用于学习拆解；发布或商用前回到原页面确认授权。
